measurement.whole_recompute: release atlas-systemizer systemize --root . (118 artifacts): 10.45 s cold, 9.01 s and 8.86 s with a warm extraction cache; recensus snapshot 7.5 s
measurement.extraction_share: the warm cache removes ~1.5 s (~14%): the only per-artifact derivation, already memoized by the absorbed ExtractionCache
measurement.stage_profile: gdb stack sampling during systemize (17 samples): normalization 5, graph build 4, closure checks (is_closed / typed_references_resolve) 2, report serialization/write/drop 5, census 1 -- no dominant stage; ADR 0008's 166 s (debug) graph-summarization hotspot no longer exists
measurement.changed_sets: changed census paths per generation, G86-G114: median 1, mean 1.72, max 16 of 118 artifacts
measurement.verdict: the delta is small, but everything outside extraction is whole-program work over cross-artifact dependencies; dependency-tracked invalidation would need normalization and graph construction restructured as tracked queries to save at most ~8.5 s per run -- not justified at this scale (the same conclusion G80 reached for differential-dataflow)
